# Ones Ben Rhaime

> Full-stack product engineer based in Tunis, Tunisia. Builds AI-powered products and scalable web applications end to end: frontend, backend, databases, data migration and technical SEO. Open to full-stack, frontend, backend and product engineering roles, remote or on-site.

## Roles
- Full-Stack Developer / Full-Stack Engineer
- Product Engineer / Full-Stack Product Engineer
- Frontend Developer (React, Next.js, TypeScript)
- Backend Developer (Node.js, NestJS, REST APIs, microservices)

## Skills
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, responsive UI, performance
- Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, REST APIs, microservice architecture
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, schema design, data migration
- AI: LLM integration, AI-powered product features
- SEO: technical SEO, structured data, Core Web Vitals
- DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, Docker

## Experience
- Full-Stack Product Engineer — PrimeProfs (AI-powered EdTech)
- Frontend & API Developer — Caustaza Group LTD
- Full-Stack JS Engineer — Orange Digital Center (Tunis)
- Internships: Smartovate, Paysan du Cap Bon, BIAT, Cloud Master Tunisie
